name: Visily
description: Visily turns text prompts, screenshots, and hand-drawn sketches into editable wireframes, mockups, and clickable prototypes on a single collaborative canvas. It targets non-designers — founders, PMs, and engineers — with drag-and-drop components, AI-assisted layout, and a short learning curve. Designs import from and export to Figma, and a generous free Starter tier needs no credit card.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary AI design models; no model selection exposed.

edge: Turns screenshots, sketches, and text prompts into editable high-fidelity UI in minutes — built for non-designers, not Figma pros.
cons: Not a full pro design tool
